# The sheet stack on shared/layer.js (pageSheet / runSheet / closeSheet / Escape / the discard question /
# Set for this style), one act per block, each on a fresh page. "facts" is the sheet, the layer's depth, body scroll
# lock, the page's sheet state and the question; "focus" is every element focus() was called on during the act.

## pageSheet: the style menu's Rename sheet, then Cancel
before: sheet closed, #pd-scrim markup empty, layers 0, body overflow "", S.sheet null, question none
after Style B ⋯ › Rename: sheet open (the layer's shell), #pd-scrim markup empty, layers 1, body overflow "hidden", S.sheet set, question none
modal: class "layer-card layer-sheet pd-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Rename Style B"
header: "Rename Style B", sub ""
fields: name
footer: status(layer-status) · btn "Cancel" · btn btn-primary [data-layer-ok] "Rename"
inner popover: #pd-advpop, hidden
focus: input.pd-inp wide
active element: set
pd-pop hidden, pd-stpop absent, pd-advpop hidden
after Cancel: sheet closed, #pd-scrim markup empty, layers 0, body overflow "", S.sheet null, question none
focus: div[data-act="style-menu"]

## the backdrop (ruling 2: the Processes sheets opt in)
nothing typed, pressed and released on the backdrop: sheet closed, #pd-scrim markup empty, layers 0, body overflow "", S.sheet null, question none
pressed in the card, released on the backdrop: sheet open (the layer's shell), #pd-scrim markup empty, layers 1, body overflow "hidden", S.sheet set, question none
a typed name, pressed and released on the backdrop: sheet open (the layer's shell), #pd-scrim markup empty, layers 2, body overflow "hidden", S.sheet set, question "Discard the changes?" [Keep editing · Discard]
Keep editing: sheet open (the layer's shell), #pd-scrim markup empty, layers 1, body overflow "hidden", S.sheet set, question none; name reads "Style B typed"

## runSheet: OK pressed twice before the first write answers
between the presses: sheet open (the layer's shell), #pd-scrim markup empty, layers 1, body overflow "hidden", S.sheet set, question none, OK disabled
requests: PUT /api/styles/2 · POST /api/processes/1/flow/preview
after: sheet closed, #pd-scrim markup empty, layers 0, body overflow "", S.sheet null, question none

## runSheet: a refused run, then OK again
first press: PUT /api/styles/2 → sheet: open "Rename Style B", status "the Edge refused it" (bad), OK "Rename" enabled
second press: PUT /api/styles/2 · POST /api/processes/1/flow/preview → sheet: closed

## closeSheet: what it clears (Add process on Settings)
open Add process, a name typed: sheet open (the layer's shell), #pd-scrim markup empty, layers 1, body overflow "hidden", S.sheet set, question none; pickers parts, scr-11, scr-12, scr-none
after Cancel: sheet closed, #pd-scrim markup empty, layers 0, body overflow "", S.sheet null, question none; pickers parts (Settings’ own pickers stay: their boxes are in #pd-root)

## closeSheet: the apply modal's ticks go with it
apply modal, Style B ticked: sheet open (#pd-scrim), #pd-scrim markup drawn, layers 1, body overflow "hidden", S.sheet set, question none; S.papply rows 2
after Cancel: sheet closed, #pd-scrim markup empty, layers 0, body overflow "", S.sheet null, question none; S.papply null
reopened: nothing ticked

## closeSheet: New style's spots go with it
New style, Recipe One picked: sheet open (the layer's shell), #pd-scrim markup empty, layers 1, body overflow "hidden", S.sheet set, question none; S.newStyle set
after Cancel: sheet closed, #pd-scrim markup empty, layers 0, body overflow "", S.sheet null, question none; S.newStyle null

## Escape: the page popover (#pd-pop) with no sheet
style menu open: pd-pop open, pd-stpop absent, pd-advpop absent
Escape → sheet closed, #pd-scrim markup empty, layers 0, body overflow "", S.sheet null, question none; pd-pop hidden, pd-stpop absent, pd-advpop absent

## Escape: Settings' group list (#pd-stpop)
Settings group list open: pd-pop hidden, pd-stpop open, pd-advpop absent
Escape → sheet closed, #pd-scrim markup empty, layers 0, body overflow "", S.sheet null, question none; pd-pop hidden, pd-stpop hidden, pd-advpop absent

## Escape: a popover in a sheet (#pd-advpop), then the sheet (nothing typed)
Add process with its group list open: sheet open (the layer's shell), #pd-scrim markup empty, layers 2, body overflow "hidden", S.sheet set, question none; pd-pop hidden, pd-stpop absent, pd-advpop open
Escape → sheet open (the layer's shell), #pd-scrim markup empty, layers 1, body overflow "hidden", S.sheet set, question none; pd-pop hidden, pd-stpop absent, pd-advpop hidden
Escape → sheet closed, #pd-scrim markup empty, layers 0, body overflow "", S.sheet null, question none; pd-pop hidden, pd-stpop absent, pd-advpop absent

## Escape: Set for this style's setting list (a popover on the tab, no sheet)
Set for this style › + Add a setting: sheet closed, #pd-scrim markup empty, layers 1, body overflow "", S.sheet null, question none; pd-pop open, pd-stpop absent, pd-advpop absent
Escape → sheet closed, #pd-scrim markup empty, layers 0, body overflow "", S.sheet null, question none; pd-pop hidden, pd-stpop absent, pd-advpop absent
nothing picked: dirty=false; requests none

## Set for this style: a number typed is the style draft's, and Escape takes nothing away
typed 7 into lineside_soft_threshold on POS_A1: dirty=true; sheet closed, #pd-scrim markup empty, layers 0, body overflow "", S.sheet null, question none
Escape → dirty=true; sheet closed, #pd-scrim markup empty, layers 0, body overflow "", S.sheet null, question none; pd-pop hidden, pd-stpop absent, pd-advpop absent

## the discard question on a sheet: a typed name, Escape, Keep editing, OK
Escape → sheet "Rename Style B"; sheet open (the layer's shell), #pd-scrim markup empty, layers 2, body overflow "hidden", S.sheet set, question "Discard the changes?" [Keep editing · Discard]; pd-pop hidden, pd-stpop absent, pd-advpop hidden
question: "Discard the changes?", buttons "Keep editing" · "Discard"
Keep editing → sheet "Rename Style B", name reads "Style B typed"; sheet open (the layer's shell), #pd-scrim markup empty, layers 1, body overflow "hidden", S.sheet set, question none
then OK (the sheet's own run): PUT /api/styles/2 {"name":"Style B typed","description":"","process_id":1,"expected_catid":""}

## the discard question on a sheet: a typed name, Escape, Discard
Escape → sheet "Rename Style B"; sheet open (the layer's shell), #pd-scrim markup empty, layers 2, body overflow "hidden", S.sheet set, question "Discard the changes?" [Keep editing · Discard]; pd-pop hidden, pd-stpop absent, pd-advpop hidden
Discard → sheet closed, #pd-scrim markup empty, layers 0, body overflow "", S.sheet null, question none; requests none

## Escape with no layer: a pinned recipe group lets go
recipe group 0 pinned: S.shapeDraft.focus {"g":0}
Escape → S.shapeDraft.focus null; sheet closed, #pd-scrim markup empty, layers 0, body overflow "", S.sheet null, question none; pd-pop hidden, pd-stpop absent, pd-advpop absent

## Escape with no layer: the selected position lets go (then nothing)
row POS_A3 clicked: S.selected "POS_A3"
Escape → S.selected null; sheet closed, #pd-scrim markup empty, layers 0, body overflow "", S.sheet null, question none; pd-pop hidden, pd-stpop absent, pd-advpop absent
Escape → S.selected null; sheet closed, #pd-scrim markup empty, layers 0, body overflow "", S.sheet null, question none; pd-pop hidden, pd-stpop absent, pd-advpop absent

## facts
body scroll lock: overflow "hidden" while a sheet is up, "" once it closes (the layer's counted lock; every block above)
focus() calls across every block above: 24
Escape: document keydown listeners per page, at most 2 (the page's own, for nothing open; the layer's, added with its first entry); the window listeners boot adds: error, unhandledrejection, resize, focus
